name: Open edX
summary: An open-source learning platform combining a learner-facing LMS with Open edX Studio authoring, designed for large-scale online courses, programs and credentials.

value.freeTierNote: Yes. Open edX platform code is open source and can be self-hosted; managed hosting, support and implementation are chargeable through providers.

value.from: Open edX core software: free (open-source licence); hosting and services priced by the selected provider.
value.notes: There is no single Open edX SaaS price. Total cost depends on hosting provider, implementation, integrations, support and scale.

value.evidence: Accessibility depends on the Open edX release, theme, customisations and course content; request provider-specific ACR/VPAT. No universal platform-wide conformance claim entered; evaluate the deployed release and customised learner/admin journeys.

security.notes: Security is deployment/provider dependent; obtain hosting provider SOC/ISO assurance and review the security of the selected Open edX release.
